methodology: The Red Herring Prospectus is a 127-page real-world financial document. A full manually-annotated ground truth for all 127 pages was not feasible to create in isolation. This file documents the detector's predictions as a reference dataset, along with the independently verified evaluation results from the controlled test dataset (pii_redaction_test.docx).

post_redaction_validation.replacement_consistency_note: 31 detections were de-duplicated (overlapping spans merged at redaction time), hence replacements_applied (3514) < detections (3545). This is expected behaviour.

controlled_evaluation_dataset.description: A synthetic 35-entity DOCX document with independently annotated ground truth covering all 9 PII categories. Used to produce the verifiable TP/FP/FN metrics below.

results.false_positives_notes: 2 FP: one ORGANIZATION detection on a generic legal phrase; one PERSON detection on a capitalized heading.
results.false_negatives_notes: 2 FN: one ADDRESS split across an unusual paragraph boundary; one PERSON with no leading honorific or context.
results.accuracy_note: Conventional accuracy (TP+TN)/(TP+TN+FP+FN) is NOT calculated. For sparse span extraction, True Negatives are the infinite set of all non-PII character spans — undefined and unenumerable. Precision, Recall, and F1 are the scientifically correct metrics.

why_prospectus_precision_recall_is_na: The Red Herring Prospectus has no independently annotated ground truth. Using detector predictions as their own ground truth would produce trivially inflated 100% metrics which would be scientifically dishonest. The system correctly reports N/A for Precision/Recall/F1 on this document and directs the reviewer to the controlled evaluation dataset above.
